kind: independent actual-display visual review of frozen feedback recheck
method: Independently viewed all 16 listed actual displayed BMPs, then recomputed their sizes and SHA-256 against the audited artifact member index. These are fresh recheck captures of unchanged ff13 application bytes, not substitutes from a previous candidate or independent oracle rasters.
conclusion: Both ordinary and spaces paths now have reviewed, populated 960/1024 overflow desktops and stable collapse/expand endpoints. No additional visible layout defect is found. Both caption pairs show the runner-console obstruction before activation and the unobstructed populated application after activation. The ordinary overflow scope unreached in the original run is now covered by this separate recheck and its passing native feedback gate.
limits: These static endpoints do not prove absence of transient flashing; the tied native temporal gate supplies that separate sampled evidence.
Both cases required one ordinary click on an exposed owned caption at the modal-close setup boundary. This is not a claim of automatic foreground restoration after closing the modal.
Only hosted Windows and the captured DPI/window sizes were reviewed. High DPI, multiple monitors, representative PCs and screen-reader acceptance remain untested.
The first 25-image review remains unchanged and still records the historical ordinary-path obstruction; this receipt adds later evidence rather than rewriting that result.
